verdict.rationale: Google ADK ships an official CLI (`adk`) documented in the GitHub repo with concrete commands for running, testing, evaluating, and deploying agents (adk run, adk web, adk eval, adk deploy docker/cloud_run), plus a separate 'Agents CLI' for AI-native scaffolding workflows mentioned in official docs. This is first-party, well-documented, and shows actual command usage. Missing for 10: independent/third-party hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs and repo README.
